headline: Oricon Enterprises Submits AGM Voting Results and Scrutinizer Report
hook: Post-AGM disclosures filed by Oricon Enterprises
summary: Oricon Enterprises Limited has submitted the official scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. These filings complete the mandatory post-AGM compliance process required by stock exchanges. Retail shareholders can review the accepted resolutions and voting patterns on the exchange portals.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no immediate financial impact
